levels.surface: عبيد الله بن عمر بن ميسرة

notes: The asker «قال سألت هشام بن عروة» is Hassan, the narrator already written: not repeated.
Urwa is named inside Hisham's words («كان عروة يقطعه ... وقال لا بأس به»): whether his words make him a link, or only the story, cannot be settled from the text (rule 6); not written.
«سمعت من يقول بمكة لعن رسول الله» is a first-person narrative with an unnamed source inside the saying (rule 11): not written.
«زاد حميد» and «ثم ساق معناه» are a wording addition and a remark: left out.
